issue.title: Add Cloudflare to Flask Hosting Platforms docs?

summary.text: This is a documentation request to add Cloudflare Workers’ Flask deployment guide to Flask’s “Hosting Platforms” section. The latest maintainer response invites the reporter to open a pull request and pass Cloudflare the Pallets donation link, without promising placement or any service in exchange.

known_facts.text: The reporter says Cloudflare Workers supports deploying Flask applications and links to Cloudflare’s short deployment guide.
A maintainer initially noted that the guide’s referenced examples repository did not contain the example; the reporter subsequently said it had been merged and was now present.
The maintainer expressed concern that company-submitted hosting links can resemble advertising, but said Cloudflare is comparable in scale to platforms already listed.
The maintainer later invited the reporter to open a pull request and asked them to pass along the Pallets donation link.
Two repository-scoped searches found no eligible related-issue candidates beyond the target issue.

label_recommendations.name: docs
label_recommendations.reason: The request proposes adding an external deployment-guide link to Flask’s Hosting Platforms documentation.

draft_reply: Thanks for following up and for adding the missing example. Given Cloudflare’s scale relative to the other platforms listed, please go ahead and open a PR adding the guide to the Hosting Platforms documentation. Please also pass our donation link (https://palletsprojects.com/donate) to the appropriate team at Cloudflare. To be clear, this is not a promise of placement or any particular service in exchange for a donation; the documentation change will still be reviewed on its own merits.
limitations: The Cloudflare guide, examples repository, Flask documentation, source code, and release history were not independently inspected.
Duplicate checking was limited to two repository issue searches; no eligible candidate was available for a full comparison.
This was a read-only investigation, so no pull request was reviewed or opened and no label was applied.
